full_judgment:
2. Facts, for disposal of the appeal in short are that the respondent Nos. 1 and 5 as plaintiffs filed Title. Suit No. 113 of 1984 before the Court of Subordinate judge, Chuadanga for declaration of title, correction of record of right and partition stating, inter alia that 8.93 acres of land in C.S Khatian No. 324 under khatian No.325-328 and 579 belonged to Pachi Bibi in 2 annas share and Moser Mondal in 14 annas share. Pachi Bibi died leaving behind only son Meser Mondal who sold the entire property to Lokman Mondal. Lokman Mondal died leaving behind son Vagyaban Modndal, daughter Suburan Nessa Bibi and wife Sharifan Bibi, Vagyaban Mondal was killed by tiger while he was one year old. Thus the entire property developed upon Saburan Nessa Bibi and Sharifan bibi. Saburon Nessa Bibi sold 4.73 acres of land to proforma defendant No.4 on 14.07.67. Proforma defendant No.4 sold the same to the plaintiffs and defendant No.3 on 05.01.1968. While the plaintiffs were possessing that land defendant Nos.1 2 and 3 threatened to dispossess them. At that time defendant Nos.1 and 2 informed that the RS record had been prepared in the name of their mother. On 25th Chaitra 1377 B.S. the plaintiffs went to pay rent to the Tahsil Office then finally came to know about the wrong record. The plaintiffs filed Title Suit No. 359/73 before the Court of Munsif, Chuadanga for declaration of title and rectification of record. The said suit was contested by defendant Nos.1 and 2 by filing written statements stating, inter alia that minor Vagyaban Mondal, Suburan Nessa and their mother Sharifan Nessa had sold out the property to them. But actually though they purchased the property but did not possess it. Hence, the suit. 

 3. The suit was contested by defendant Nos.1 and 2 by filing written statement denying all the material allegations made in the plaint contending, inter alia, that 8.93 acres of land appertaining to CS Khatian No.324 Mouza Khathuli belonged to Pachi Bibi in 2 annas share and Meser Mondal 14 annas share. Meser Mondal became the heir of his mother Pachi Bibi after her death, Meser Mondal died leaving only sister's son Bisha Joarder, who sold the entire property to Lokman Mondal. Lokman Mondal died leaving behind wife Sharifan Nessa scn Vagyaban and Minor daughter Sabrota Nessa @ Saburon Nessa Bibi. After the death of Lokman Mondal his widow Sharifan Nessa with her minor son and daughter fell on bad days. As a result Sharifan Nessa being guardian of her minor son and daughter sold 7.21 acres of land to Surya Nessa and defendant Nos.3. After sale Sharifan Nessa Bibi along with her son and daughter went to her father's house at village Bagundi. At that time defendant No.3 was minor and his father used to possess that property in his favour. During S.A operation the suit land was correctly recorded in the name of Surya Nessa Bibi and defendant No.3 R.S record had also been prepared rightly in the name of those defendants. The plaintiffs and defendant. No.3 is full brother and other plaintiffs are full sister's sons of the defendants. The defendant No.3 has been possessing 8 annas share of the suit property.
